evidence.text: To compare an application's needs with stored keys, the names the code reads must be found.
A deterministic scanner can recognize common patterns (process.env, os.environ, std::env::var, framework settings) but not dynamic names or unsupported languages.
An LLM can read arbitrary code and find more names, but its output is non-deterministic and can be wrong.

desiredImprovement: Completeness of the list of names the application reads
worseningOutcome: Determinism and verifiability of that list
